title: Belurya the Convert
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: She is mentioned in Rosh Hashanah 17b, where she asked Rabban Gamliel, “It is written, ‘who shows no favor,’ yet it is also written, ‘May the Lord show you favor,’” etc. Rabbi Yose the Priest engaged with her and answered her. Yevamot 46a and Mekhilta, Bo, chapter 15, relate the incident of Belurya the convert, whose slaves immersed before she did.
